mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 70 degrees. We also have a Waning Gibbous moon out, and if you are an early riser, the International Space Station will be visible at 4:14 AM, rising over Verona High School and heading toward Home Depot for four minutes.

We have several important proclamations this month, including Hunger Action Month and Suicide Prevention Month to support community health. Additionally, Mayor Diaz has declared today as Building Inspector and Code Staff Appreciation Day to honor those who keep our infrastructure safe, and please be aware that flagging on Highway M continues for utility work.

There is a lot to do in Verona today, including the Verona Area Kids Triathlon, the Girls Try Hockey event at the ice arena, and live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy trivia at the Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee starting this Tuesday.

Regarding the latest police report, on August 17, officers responded to the 500 block of Cross Country Road to assist the Department of Corrections in taking a 21-year-old man into custody for a probation violation.
Today's featured flavor at Culver's is the delicious Crazy for Cookie Dough. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
